department: Multidisciplinary Biomedical and Biological Sciences (MBBS) Graduate Program

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline for the PhD.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required but strongly encouraged.
gre_general.quote: While not required, applicants are strongly encouraged to submit Graduate Record Examination

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: PhD applicants must name two or three faculty members whose research matches theirs.
supervisor.quote: Thesis M.S. and Ph.D. applicants must also identify 2-3 faculty members with whom their research interests align

funding.value: Fellowships or assistantships may be available for qualified applicants in one concentration only.
funding.quote: Fellowships or research assistantships may be available through the Anatomy & Neurobiology Concentration for qualified thesis M.S. and Ph.D. applicants

entry_route.value: A bachelor's-only applicant can be admitted directly, but only very strong applicants are considered.
entry_route.quote: may be admitted to the doctoral program with a B.S. degree only

notes: An umbrella program with several concentrations, including Pharmacology & Neuroscience (listed as neuro) and Cell Biology and Microbiology (listed as biology). The catalog describes a Ph.D. in each concentration. Department and deadline pages were not checked.
name: Ph.D. in Biomedical and Biological Sciences (MBBS umbrella)
